_comment: Shared manifest corpus. This exact file is duplicated in motion-back at
src/plugins/__fixtures__/manifests.json, and BOTH validators run it.
The two run in different processes on different machines and neither can
import the other, so 'the registry accepts what the editor accepts' cannot
be guaranteed by sharing code. It can be guaranteed by sharing CASES: a
package the registry accepts and the editor then refuses is a user who
installed something that does not work, and a package the registry refuses
and the editor would have accepted is a publisher who cannot ship.
Keep the two copies byte-identical. Add a case to both or to neither.
